'''Mensant''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. When the financier [[Veilred Jydor]] offered a rare [[Tchine]] statue as a prize in a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] tournament that was to be held in the [[High Card Casino]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Danteel]], Mensant participated in the competition on the behalf of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Arvakke]], who had attempted to rig the tournament. Using a [[Skifter/Legends|skifter]] to cheat, the gambler [[Phramp]] deliberately threw hands to Mensant once every eight rounds, and Mensant soon built up a lead. However, the rival players [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Zerba Cher'dak]] realized that something was amiss, and Cher'dak began cheating to counteract Phramp's efforts and reduce Mensant's lead.
